scope: Constructive identifiability counterexample, not a new aliasing theorem or nonlinear benchmark
observed_variable: position only; mass and momentum are not supplied
evaluation: Verify identical entire sampled position Gaussian law, distinct forced response, and an extra off-grid equilibrium lag that distinguishes this finite family
controls: zero alias separation gives same system
information_rule: Exact stationary sampled positions only; off-grid covariance and model masses are withheld extra information, not training features
